levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب
سعد بن عبد الله بن أبي خلف
محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: Three «حدثني» routes, each ending «مثله» (the same saying): three groups; names repeat, so the tail is null. The compiler's father («أبي») and brother («أخي») are named only by relation.

The Imam is last in each route: in the first he is named in the words after the chain («قلت لأبي عبد الله ... فقال لا»), so imam_in_text; in the other two he is written inside the chain after «عن» and stays narrator.
